collate_dinov2_samples: collate DINOv2 training samples with global and local crops into stacked tensors
generate_patch_masks: generate random boolean masks for a subset of samples based on mask probability and ratio
compute_mask_indices: compute flattened mask indices and weights for masked patch prediction in DINOv2
cast_tensors_to_dtype: cast collated global and local crop tensors to a specified PyTorch dtype
shuffle_masked_samples: shuffle mask assignments across samples so masked and unmasked samples are randomized
